about: Synthetic golden cases for Nexus's model-facing behaviour, built from failure modes seen in real traces (evals/README.md). No real data: every company, person, address and text here is invented. A run happens at the real present in the case's time zone (the voice model knows today's date by itself); expected times are relative to it. `now` is the reference the offline tests use, Wednesday 2026-03-04 10:15 CET. Run paid sessions between 10:00 and 23:00 Madrid time on a Tuesday to Sunday, so that 'this morning at nine' lies in the past and 'Monday' means the last one.
